subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Keep existing features on their frozen documents, checks, and bindings, and defer moving them into drafts to WR-5.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: The operator scoped the release to day one (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-26): new features start as drafts and no migration ships, so an existing feature's contract stays its merged documents (NR-5) and the document pipeline's checks keep guarding them (FR-30, NR-3).
fit_criterion: After the switch-over, an existing fixture feature keeps its merged PRD projection, live designs, and projected plans unchanged, and its documents still trigger the existing immutability refusals.
